title: CaseBoxClaimTrack
description: Pre-trial/trial-mode claim track (frozen spec §1): the reasoning spine for one claim — a main claim OR a counterclaim. Records who is claimant/respondent and whether OUR side is asserting or responding (the our_role abstraction that supports all four plaintiff/defendant × asserting/responding scenarios A-D without hardcoded workflows). A matter may carry one main_claim plus one or more counterclaim tracks; this schema imposes no maximum-counterclaim constraint. Anchor/link, evidence-preparation, cross-examination and legal-opinion-card models attach to a claim track in later WIs (PTA-05+). This WI is contract-only: no persistence, IPC, renderer, or referential (party-in-matter) validation.

track_type.description: Whether this track is the matter's main claim or a counterclaim. A matter may hold one main_claim and any number of counterclaim tracks (no schema-level maximum).

claimant_party_id.description: The party asserting this claim (references a party ULID; referential existence against the matter's parties is a later handler preflight, NOT a schema constraint).

respondent_party_id.description: The party defending this claim (references a party ULID; referential existence is a later handler preflight, NOT a schema constraint).

our_role.description: Whether OUR client's side is asserting (claimant) or responding (respondent) on this track. Independent of plaintiff/defendant: all four track_type × our_role combinations are valid (scenarios A-D).

title.description: Lawyer-entered display name for the claim track. Non-empty.

claim_summary.description: The claim as stated. type string; empty string allowed so a responding track can leave this empty while the key stays present (no null, no cross-field invariant).

response_summary.description: The response/defense as stated. type string; empty string allowed so an asserting track can leave this empty while the key stays present (no null, no cross-field invariant).

legal_basis.description: The legal basis for the claim/response. type string; empty string allowed.

calculation_summary.description: Damages/relief calculation summary. type string; empty string allowed.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the claim track.

sort_order.description: Lawyer-controlled display order within the matter's claim tracks.
